author: As told by a Skaal elder
pages:
#The Six

The All-Maker made the world and left its strength in six stones on this island: Earth, Water, Wind, Sun, Beast and Tree. The Skaal keep them. We do not pray to them. We listen.

When the stones are well, the wind is honest and the hunt is fair.

#The Sickness

There are stories of a time when a stranger made the stones speak in his voice instead, and the Skaal walked in their sleep to build him temples. It ended when a greater voice broke his hold.

The young ones think it is only a story. The shamans do not.
